title: DestinationGuide: efecto de guia hacia la casa de entrega
request: PETICION del usuario: un efecto mejor para guiar al jugador hasta la casa indicada. Nuevo LocalScript autonomo StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.DestinationGuide que lee los atributos del jugador (DeliveryState, DeliveryDestPos, DeliveryDestName) y dibuja: casa de destino RESALTADA con Highlight visible incluso tras las paredes, pilar de neon pulsante de 140 studs, anillo pulsante en el suelo de la puerta, cartel flotante con el nombre de la casa y la distancia en studs, rastro de 12 flechas de neon que fluyen desde el jugador hacia la casa, y brujula en el borde de la pantalla cuando la casa no esta a la vista. El color pasa de azul a amarillo a verde segun te acercas (120 y 40 studs). No se toca el HUD: el script oculta la baliza antigua con LocalTransparencyModifier para no duplicar efectos. Se cierra con lint_scripts sobre StarterPlayer.

operations.source:
--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🧭 DESTINATION GUIDE · guía visual hasta la casa de entrega
--   🏠 la casa se RESALTA (se ve incluso tras las paredes)
--   🔆 pilar de neón + anillo pulsante en la puerta
--   ➡️ rastro de flechas que fluyen desde ti hasta la casa
--   🧭 brújula en el borde si la casa no está a la vista
--   🎨 color por distancia: azul (lejos) → amarillo → verde
--
-- Es autónomo: solo lee los atributos del jugador
-- (DeliveryState, DeliveryDestPos, DeliveryDestName).
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local guide = { chevrons = {} }
local lastDestKey = nil
local edge = nil
local nextLegacy = 0

local function buildGui()
	if edge then return end
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "DeliveryGuideGui"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.Name = "EdgeArrow"
	lbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56)
	lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lbl.TextSize = 42
	lbl.Text = "➤"
	lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
	lbl.Visible = false
	lbl.Parent = gui
	edge = lbl
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Construcción de las piezas del mundo (una sola vez)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function buildGuide()
	if guide.folder then return end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "DeliveryGuide"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	guide.folder = folder

	local pillar = Instance.new("Part")
	pillar.Name = "Pillar"
	pillar.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 140, 2.4)
	pillar.Anchored = true
	pillar.CanCollide = false
	pillar.CanQuery = false
	pillar.CanTouch = false
	pillar.CastShadow = false
	pillar.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	pillar.Transparency = 0.72
	pillar.Parent = folder
	guide.pillar = pillar

	local ring = Instance.new("Part")
	ring.Name = "Ring"
	ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 24, 24)
	ring.Anchored = true
	ring.CanCollide = false
	ring.CanQuery = false
	ring.CanTouch = false
	ring.CastShadow = false
	ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ring.Transparency = 0.5
	ring.Parent = folder
	guide.ring = ring

	local board = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	board.Name = "Board"
	board.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 112)
	board.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)
	board.AlwaysOnTop = true
	board.Adornee = pillar
	board.Parent = pillar
	guide.board = board

	local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	arrow.Name = "Arrow"
	arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	arrow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
	arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	arrow.TextSize = 40
	arrow.Text = "▼"
	arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	arrow.Parent = board
	guide.arrow = arrow

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 44)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 20
	title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
	title.Text = ""
	title.Parent = board
	guide.title = title

	local dist = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	dist.Name = "Dist"
	dist.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	dist.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 78)
	dist.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
	dist.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	dist.TextSize = 16
	dist.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	dist.Text = ""
	dist.Parent = board
	guide.dist = dist

	local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
	hl.Name = "HouseHighlight"
	hl.FillTransparency = 0.75
	hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
	hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	hl.Parent = folder
	guide.highlight = hl

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local ch = Instance.new("WedgePart")
		ch.Name = "Chevron" .. i
		ch.Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 0.3, 2.4)
		ch.Anchored = true
		ch.CanCollide = false
		ch.CanQuery = false
		ch.CanTouch = false
		ch.CastShadow = false
		ch.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		ch.Transparency = 1
		ch.Parent = folder
		guide.chevrons[i] = ch
	end
end

local function hideGuide()
	if not guide.folder then return end
	guide.pillar.Transparency = 1
	guide.ring.Transparency = 1
	guide.board.Enabled = false
	guide.highlight.Adornee = nil
	for _, ch in ipairs(guide.chevrons) do
		ch.Transparency = 1
	end
	if edge then
		edge.Visible = false
	end
	lastDestKey = nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🏠 Resalta el edificio del destino (1 búsqueda por destino)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function refreshHighlight(destPos)
	local key = string.format("%.1f_%.1f_%.1f", destPos.X, destPos.Y, destPos.Z)
	if key == lastDestKey then return end
	lastDestKey = key
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { guide.folder }
	local ok, parts = pcall(function()
		return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(destPos, 12, params)
	end)
	if not ok or not parts then
		guide.highlight.Adornee = nil
		return
	end
	local best, bestVol = nil, 0
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		local m = p:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local isChar = m ~= nil and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil
		if not isChar then
			local s = p.Size
			local vol = s.X * s.Y * s.Z
			if vol > bestVol then
				best = m or p
				bestVol = vol
			end
		end
	end
	guide.highlight.Adornee = best
end

-- oculta la baliza del HUD antiguo para no duplicar efectos
local function hideLegacyBeacon()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < nextLegacy then return end
	nextLegacy = now + 0.5
	for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if inst ~= guide.folder then
			local n = string.lower(inst.Name)
			local legacy = string.find(n, "beacon", 1, true) or string.find(n, "deliverybeam", 1, true)
			if legacy then
				if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
					inst.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end
				for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("PointLight") then
						d.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Actualización por fotograma
------------------------------------------------------------
local function updateGuide(char, destPos, destName)
	buildGuide()
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		hideGuide()
		return
	end
	local t = os.clock()
	local flatDist = (Vector3.new(destPos.X, 0, destPos.Z) - Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z)).Magnitude
	local color
	if flatDist > 120 then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 200, 255)
	elseif flatDist > 40 then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90)
	else
		color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 240, 150)
	end
	local pulse = math.sin(t * 3)

	guide.pillar.Color = color
	guide.pillar.CFrame = CFrame.new(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 70, 0))
	guide.pillar.Transparency = 0.7 + 0.1 * pulse

	guide.ring.Color = color
	local ringSize = 22 + 5 * pulse
	guide.ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, ringSize, ringSize)
	guide.ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	guide.ring.Transparency = 0.45 + 0.15 * pulse

	guide.board.Enabled = true
	guide.board.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 20 + math.sin(t * 4) * 1.2, 0)
	guide.arrow.TextColor3 = color
	guide.title.Text = "🏠 " .. destName
	guide.dist.Text = math.floor(flatDist + 0.5) .. " studs"
	guide.dist.TextColor3 = color

	guide.highlight.FillColor = color
	guide.highlight.OutlineColor = color
	refreshHighlight(destPos)

	-- ➡️ rastro de flechas que fluye hacia la casa
	if flatDist > 6 then
		local dir = Vector3.new(destPos.X - hrp.Position.X, 0, destPos.Z - hrp.Position.Z)
		local u = dir.Unit
		local span = math.min(flatDist - 3, 55)
		local flow = (t * 0.35) % 1
		local n = #guide.chevrons
		for i, ch in ipairs(guide.chevrons) do
			local f = (((i - 1) / n) + flow) % 1
			local d = 4 + f * span
			local pos = hrp.Position + u * d + Vector3.new(0, -2.2, 0)
			ch.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + u)
			ch.Color = color
			ch.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.6 * f
		end
	else
		for _, ch in ipairs(guide.chevrons) do
			ch.Transparency = 1
		end
	end

	-- 🧭 brújula de borde si la casa no está a la vista
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam and edge then
		local vp = cam.ViewportSize
		local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(destPos)
		local margin = 70
		local inside = onScreen and sp.X > margin and sp.X < vp.X - margin
			and sp.Y > margin and sp.Y < vp.Y - margin
		if inside then
			edge.Visible = false
		else
			local center = Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
			local target = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
			if sp.Z <= 0 then
				target = Vector2.new(vp.X - sp.X, vp.Y - sp.Y)
			end
			local d2 = target - center
			if d2.Magnitude < 1 then
				d2 = Vector2.new(0, -1)
			else
				d2 = d2.Unit
			end
			local radius = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * 0.36
			local p2 = center + d2 * radius
			edge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p2.X, p2.Y)
			edge.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d2.Y, d2.X))
			edge.TextColor3 = color
			edge.Visible = true
		end
	end
end

buildGui()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local state = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryState")
	local destPos = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDestPos")
	local active = (state == "Active" or state == "Dropped") and typeof(destPos) == "Vector3"
	if active then
		local name = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDestName") or "Destino"
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			updateGuide(player.Character, destPos, name)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[DestinationGuide] " .. tostring(err))
		end
	else
		hideGuide()
	end
	hideLegacyBeacon()
end)
